build_vision_encoder_subclass: build a python module that subclasses VisionEncoder and implements encode and get_transform methods
create_perception_encoder: create a PerceptionEncoder instance from a PerceptionEncoderConfig to encode image features using CLIP
run_vision_encoder_forward: run the VisionEncoder forward pass on a list of video tensors to get padded feature representations
create_rescale_transform: create a RescaleTransform to resize image tensors to a target output size with a given interpolation mode
review_perception_encoder_transform: review the PerceptionEncoder get_transform method that builds a torchvision Compose pipeline with resize, normalization, and scaling
